scope: Sequential frozen stdlib exploratory probes in the v10 centre-star family and small variants over the remaining K7 2-marker tuples, K6.3 survivors and K6.2* survivors, plus centre-location variants. Exactly one python child at a time.

limits.gate: stability_gate_check_v2.py on observer v3 plus fresh statvfs >= 12.2e9+16MiB before every run; REFUSE means no run and no automatic retry

conditions: Send each new probe source SHA before its first run; record Popen PID/PGID, argv SHA, cwd, absolute end and settlement per run.
Outputs are exploratory only: never premises and never counted coverage.

A counted computational proof needs a separately frozen coupled-pattern certificate format and coverage contract, positive and mutation controls, two independently written exact checkers and a separate parent GO.
Any STOP, disk/memory notice or unsettled child latches all further runs until parent disposition.
Report cumulative compute at each checkpoint; stop at the budget or window end even if incomplete.
